entities.title: zazzle-csharp-indexer tests
entities.summary: The xunit suite for zazzle-csharp-indexer, run with dotnet test tests from the tool's folder.
entities.purpose: Checks the tool in process, without a published binary: TempRepo creates a throwaway git repository with given files and an engine on a temporary state directory, and the test classes exercise the index, analysis, tools, the terse C# view, daemon (on a temporary socket), hook policy, init and report against it; ViewTests also builds views from source text without a repository. Tests are named test_<unit>_<case> and must pass on Linux and macOS; the FSEvents test returns immediately elsewhere.
boundaries: What each test class checks is recorded in the verification.json of the folder it checks: src/Index, src/Analysis, src/Tools, src/View, src/Daemon, src/Cli and src/.
The tests need git on PATH. The external-regex test checks the fallback only where rg or a PCRE-enabled git grep is installed, and accepts bad_regex otherwise.
